Container.Name: navidrome-stat
Container.Overview: Self-hosted listening statistics for Navidrome. Explore playback history, artist and album rankings, listening charts, and monthly and yearly reviews across clients and servers. Uses a local SQLite database. Set a dashboard administrator token, then add your Navidrome servers in Settings > Connections after signing in. Recording depends on playback reported to Navidrome; installation does not recover a complete past history.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: navidrome subsonic music listening statistics history listenbrainz
Container.Requires: A reachable Navidrome server and a dedicated local appdata directory writable by UID/GID 1000:1000. Prepare the directory as described in the ReadMe before installation. Run one instance per set of sources. Use an HTTPS reverse proxy for remote access.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Dashboard port. Change the host port if it is already in use; keep container port 39421.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Dedicated local directory for SQLite, the credential key, and artwork cache. Must be writable by UID/GID 1000:1000; see the ReadMe before installing.

Config.Name: Administrator token
Config.Description: Required: enter a long, random token for dashboard login. Keep it private. Add Navidrome connections in the dashboard after signing in.

Config.Name: Database path
Config.Description: SQLite file inside the persistent appdata mount. Keep this path unchanged for normal installations.

Config.Name: Viewer token
Config.Description: Optional read-only dashboard token. Must differ from the administrator and ListenBrainz tokens. Leave empty to disable viewer access.

Config.Name: Secure session cookie
Config.Description: Set true when accessing the dashboard through HTTPS. Leave false for direct HTTP access.

Config.Name: Protect metrics
Config.Description: Require administrator authentication for the metrics endpoint.
